# Code of conduct

DroidNote is built by DroidWerk with help from people who use it. We want the issues, pull requests and discussions here to be a place where anyone can report a problem or propose an idea and be answered with respect.

## What we expect

- Be direct and kind. Disagree with ideas, not with people.
- Assume good faith. A confusing bug report is still a gift.
- Respect that maintainers and contributors give their time; a "no" to a proposal is not a judgement of the person.
- Keep private data private: never paste other people's recordings, transcripts, names or keys into an issue.

## What is not accepted

- Harassment, insults, discrimination or sexualised language, in any channel of the project.
- Publishing someone's private information.
- Sustained disruption of discussions or reviews.

## Enforcement

Report incidents to **contato@droidwerk.com.br**. Reports are read by the DroidWerk maintainers, handled in confidence, and answered within five business days. Depending on the case, the response ranges from a private note to removal from the project's spaces. Maintainers who violate this code are held to the same standard.

## Scope

This code applies to every space of the project: the GitHub repository, its issues, pull requests and discussions, and any official DroidNote channel.
